hooks.name: guard-env-write
hooks.description: Blocks the write tools (fs_write, str_replace) when the text to be written holds a value from a .env file of this project and the destination is not itself a .env file. Exit code 2 blocks the write; the reason names the file, never the value. Unparsable input is allowed. Runs through scripts/kiro-hook.sh because Kiro gives hook commands a PATH without Node.
